parts.role: Reciprocating mass that seals the cylinder and transmits combustion pressure to the rod
parts.motion: slide along vertical cylinder axis (pure up/down translation)

parts.role: Connecting rod (bronze) coupling the piston pin to the crank throw
parts.motion: planar swing: small_end translates vertically with the piston while big_end orbits the crank axis; the rod both translates and rotates each cycle

parts.role: Crank web + flywheel disc that converts reciprocation into rotation
parts.motion: rotate about crank_axis (continuous 360 deg spin); crank_pin traces a circle of radius = throw

parts.role: Left poppet valve (intake/exhaust) opening the left port
parts.motion: open/close = vertical translation along the stem axis (drops to open, springs back to close)

parts.role: Right poppet valve (intake/exhaust) opening the right port
parts.motion: open/close = vertical translation along the stem axis (drops to open, springs back to close)

fixed: spark_plug (threaded in, fires but does not translate)
valve_springs (deform/compress but are not rigid bodies)
notes: Kinematic chain: crankshaft rotates about crank_axis -> its crank_pin drives the con_rod big_end -> con_rod small_end (= piston_pin) forces the piston to slide vertically. The two valves are NOT mechanically linked to the crank in this cutaway (no cam/tappet drawn); animate them as independent vertical lift events timed to the crank angle (e.g. left opens on intake stroke, right opens on exhaust stroke). The spark plug is fixed hardware: only its electrode 'fires' (a glow/flash effect), no rigid-body motion. Valve springs should be drawn as compressing/elongating with valve travel. All coordinates are on a 0-1000 scale relative to image width (x) and height (y); the engine sits left-of-centre with empty space on the right.
